Congratulations on completing this journey! Job well done!

We hope you've enjoyed traveling with us as you:

- Created a pipeline that adds the `team` attribute to your metrics as a label
- Confirmed that the `team` label appears on your metrics
- Configured `team` as a cost attribution label in Cost Management and Billing
- Reviewed cost by team and found unattributed cost

---

- [Inject collector attributes into pipelines](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/send-data/fleet-management/set-up/configuration-pipelines/pipeline-attribute-injection/)
